notes: When pronounced 'zhòng' (4th tone), it means 'heavy'. When pronounced 'chóng' (2nd tone), it means 'to repeat' or 'again'.
Do not confuse this with '厚' (hòu), which refers to the thickness of an object (like a wall or a piece of paper), whereas '重' (zhòng) refers specifically to weight.
